dict.string: Scribe records your side of a meeting so it can transcribe it on this Mac.
Scribe records the other participants' audio so it can transcribe the meeting on this Mac.
Scribe needs to observe which applications are using the microphone in order to detect meetings.
Scribe checks your browser's open tabs for a meeting, so it doesn't mistake a video for a call. Tab addresses never leave this Mac.
Scribe reads your calendar only to name a meeting note after the event you are in.
